About Union 346

Union 346 provides its residents with unique studio, one-, two-, and income restricted three-bedroom apartment homes that feature exclusive amenities like the on-site green park, fitness center, work-from-home space, and an outdoor roof deck with views of the Boston skyline. Discover all that Somerville has to offer right outside the doors of Union 346 by bike, train, or bus. Union 346 is at the center of Somerville's many transportation options, especially the new MBTA Green Line extension. Harvard Square, Kendall Square, and downtown Boston are just minutes away making your commute a breeze. Prefer to keep it local? Take advantage of Somerville's many bike paths with easy access to restaurants, parks, and shops. Don't have your own bike? Not to worry. Blue Bikes are readily available down the street for your convenience, and you'll have access to the numerous shops and restaurants across the street at Bow Market.

    About Ward
    Two
    Ward Two, located between Union Square and Porter Square, is a residential and commercial Somerville neighborhood with triple-decker streetscapes and pocket parks. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Union Square Plaza and Somerville Avenue corridor, where indie cafes, small galleries, and chef-driven counters cluster beside longtime storefronts. Bow Market acts as a compact hub for local makers and food stalls in a courtyard setting. The Somerville Theatre adds marquee-lit culture a short walk away, pairing repertory film with live shows. Side streets mix late-19th-century wood-frame homes with brick apartment blocks, while the Community Path threads a bike-and-walk spine through the area. Seasonal programming at Union Square’s public spaces keeps the calendar active without changing the lived-in feel.
